description.value: Giardino is a Tuscan-inspired Italian restaurant on Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver, founded by chef Umberto Menghi, who received the prestigious Order of the Star of Italy in 2020. The restaurant features a Florentine-styled courtyard, a seasonal outdoor garden patio with fresh flowers and lush greens, and an interior designed to evoke old Tuscan granaries with vaulted ceilings, wooden beams, and hand-painted artwork. The menu draws on bold regional Italian flavours and spans fresh pasta, Pacific seafood, and gluten-free options.
